ctx.x: James Williams, trombone. Albert Baker, alto saxophone. And here's Leonard Davidson listed as "Big Boy." And Bert Holloway, tuba and string bass. Jimmy Warren, violin. And it says, "This unit was resident at the Creole Palace in San Diego..."
Well, of course, they were all from Los Angeles. Creole Palace, I think, was run by Ramsey, wasn't it? Does it say Ramsey?
